name: English and History Joint Major
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: English Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete any two 100-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W, ENGL 114W, ENGL 115W, ENGL 199W

requirements.title: Students also complete any four 200-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 202, ENGL 204, ENGL 209, ENGL 210, ENGL 211, ENGL 213, ENGL 214 and 3 more

sections.note: Students wishing to major in English are strongly advised to submit a formal declaration to this effect to the undergraduate advisor upon completing all lower division requirements.

requirements.title: Students complete 18 units of 100 and 200 division history courses
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least six lower division history units before enrolling in 300 division work and nine lower division history units before enrolling in 400 division work.

sections.title: English Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 20 units of upper division English courses
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of four of these units must be at the 400-level, excluding directed studies courses (ENGL 490, 491); a minimum of four units must be from the following group of courses, focused on Canadian and/or Indigenous Literatures.

requirements.title: 4 units from ENGL 355, ENGL 360, ENGL 431W, ENGL 432W

sections.note: With permission of the department, other English courses of equivalent content may be substituted for those required in this group.

sections.title: History Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 24 units of 300 and 400 level history courses, of which 12 must be in 400 level.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least one course from each group shown below.

sections.note:
Global/Comparative courses that are also included in another group may only be counted towards fulfilling the upper division course requirements for one group.
Group 4 - Global/Comparative
Group 1 - Africa, Asia, Middle East
Group 2 - The Americas
Group 3 - Europe
Students in history joint major programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
Concentration in Middle Eastern and Islamic History
Concentration in British History and Irish History
Concentration in Early Modern World History

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
